_comment: W11.Q9 (R5.9): calibrate the home-grown mutation runner (scripts/mutation/run.mjs) against StrykerJS 10 on three modules. Their tests are the files targets.json lists for each module (stryker/vitest.calibrate.config.mts). Then `node scripts/mutation/calibrate.mjs` compares the two scores; a difference of more than 5 points marks ours 'unverified'. Run: npx stryker run stryker/stryker.calibrate.json (first: --dryRunOnly).
